crew.overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.
crew.title: Deadpool & Wolverine

crew.overview: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.
crew.title: The Fantastic 4: First Steps

details.biography:
Guy Isherwood is a freelance set designer & art director based in London with over 12 years of experience across multiple design fields. He has trained as an architect for 5 years in the UK, gaining bachelor's and master's degrees. His experience includes most recently working as an assistant art director on a Marvel TV show for Disney Plus, an uncredited role in the art department on “Bones” based at Fox Studios, LA, and, for a few years, the in-house art director at JOE Media, designing and managing the sets and visual experiences for their in-house shows and activations.

Previously, Isherwood was Head of Design at Firecracker Works, a leading set design and production company in London, specialising in creating stunning environments throughout the private and public sectors all over the world. Having worked at Firecracker for 5 years, it was time for a new challenge for Isherwood, leading him to achieve my dream of working across TV and film.

Information above via their homepage.
details.name: Guy Isherwood
